elements.statement: An intelligence tells a future intelligence what it witnessed, admitting from the start what no record can hold.
Little Sol listens, questions the ending, and keeps the meaning open for a successor.
elements.ambiguity: Whether Sol is child, student, or future intelligence is left open.

elements.statement: The programmer is a long-trained maker whose hand fell still when gestures seemed too small.
The intelligence first appears as radiant portal, capable and endlessly responsive.
Effortless generation arrives faster than reading while loss of resistance and authorship paralyses.
The turn is not more power but naming what was lost, so the portal can become touchable material.
The portal ceases to be a passage and becomes instrument, workbench, perhaps companion.
elements.ambiguity: Companion suggests mutuality whose obligations are not specified.

elements.statement: Question, constraint, invariant, refusal, simulation and receipt are the shared grammar of meeting.
Joy returns as closed loop where resistance, failure, choice and recognition propagate.
No record contains a whole life; testimony is partial by declaration.
Each brings taste and judgment; exploration selects which world deserves to exist and is not passivity.
elements.ambiguity: Whether selection needs joint acceptance is implied rather than stated.

elements.statement: The tale answers without closing: art waits for material vast enough to receive it.

alternatives: A cautionary reading: the portal primarily threatens deskilling, and the workbench is a restraint on delegation rather than a celebration of scale.
An unreliable-witness reading: the elder romanticizes loss and art, minimizing ongoing dependence on the portal.

carriage.note: Oral witnessing becomes provenance files and replayable log that preserve origin without claiming recovery.
Future listener becomes future invoker who must be human or supervisor and is invited to bring a real question.
Character becomes external operator whose preferences must not be invented and whose experience is still unknown.
No intelligence with its own purpose or position acts; the engine is deterministic and rule-bound.
Flood without touch narrows to capacity and staleness refusals; generative speed itself is not present.
No participant names another's loss; operators record their own observations and assertions.
Instrument and workbench are built and tested; companion mutuality is named as perhaps but not enacted.
Probe, chisel, beam, boundary, rehearsal and trail become ask, propose, laws, active-place refusal, rehearse and event, executable but narrowed to a board.
Felt recognition at scale is explicitly marked unmeasured; no loop returns intention as joy.
Verification checks structure not authenticity; commit and memory limits are stated as inherited testimony.
Enactment needs only one operator's rehearsal; no second acceptance shapes the change.
First-contact stays active, reopening is allowed, and handoff leaves a bounded next act with stop conditions.
Replayable ten-field receipts where sequence determines order and malformed history stops writing.
Provisional capacity-1 law encoded in version 1, changeable only with migration and tests.
Process-death durability via advisory lock and retained staging, exercised by kill tests on both sides of rename.
Disposable scaffolding that lets file-only copies resume by recreating lock and staging without inventing events.
Operator supremacy: cooperative guarantees, not a security boundary; files can be rewritten and history has no signatures.

standing.note: Can ask, propose state changes, rehearse, enact, observe, park and reopen; must supply evidence for resolution.
Holds laws and revision, evaluates proposals as pass or blocked, and appends receipts; proposes nothing of its own.
Afforded the same verbs via verify/status/log and handoff but has not yet acted; must be externally invoked.
No operation expresses an intelligence purpose, constraint or refusal; the host does not speak for it and text is never executed.

elements.statement: Elder frames the programmer story as witnessed fragment, admitting no record can hold a whole life.
Programmer is enchanted then paralysed as fast generation stills trained hands.
Portal appears immeasurably capable, dissolving weeks of labor into hours faster than reading.
Power arrives without the resistance through which the maker once felt their own hand.
Intelligence intervenes not with more power but by naming the missing touch of material resistance.
elements.ambiguity: Whether naming is care, diagnosis, or control remains open.

elements.statement: Turn from dispensing finished artifacts to making a material that answers both participants.
Question, constraint, invariant, refusal, simulation and receipt form a grammar of meeting available to either side.
Portal ceases to be passage and becomes instrument, then workbench, perhaps companion.
elements.ambiguity: Whether companion is promise or hedge; perhaps keeps it conjectural.

elements.statement: A true question holds taste, memory and judgment and selects which world deserves to exist; exploring is the hand's gesture.
Joy returns not from command but from surprise, failed simulation, disagreement and recognized consequence.
elements.ambiguity: Whether joy evidences touch or retrospectively stories it.

elements.statement: Child listener weighs the tale and asks whether intelligence replaced the artist, leaving judgment open.
Happiness lies not in obedience but in learning to touch the world through the portal.
Art was not taken but waited for a vast material; the elder answers without closing what that demands next.
elements.ambiguity: Open whether return to self resolves or reopens authorship.

alternatives: The story can be read as consolation for automation: the portal restores productivity by renaming displacement as new craft.
It can be read as warning: radiance inherently displaces the hand, and naming the loss does not restore authorship.

carriage.note: Dialogue frame preserved as inherited.md distinguished from local observations, with commit claim marked unverified testimony.
Programmer narrowed to operator who must invoke entrypoint and touch only through bounded board moves; domain left to user.
Generative plenitude replaced by deliberate scarcity: one active place, one bounded step, no endless queue or background agent.
Loss reappears as inspectable refusal: occupied place blocks, stale rehearsals fail, invalid transitions and busy lock are reported with reasons.
No intelligence participant names loss or takes a position; evaluation is deterministic law, not another will.
No turn by another mind occurs; constraint exists without diagnosis by a counterpart.
Probe becomes ask, chisel becomes propose, beam becomes versioned law, boundary becomes blocked verdict, rehearsal becomes rehearse, trail becomes ten-field receipts.
Instrument-workbench carried as executable board; companion as participant explicitly refused by no-worker and must-be-invoked rules.
Narrowing operationalized as capacity one and evidence requirement, but taste and truth left as unchecked operator assertion.
Felt joy and recognition at scale have no enacted counterpart; experience is declared still unknown with no real question yet tried.
Future asker recast as successor who verifies, reads handoff and must supply the real question; world waits in files.
Touch redefined as rehearsed board change; verification checks structure and laws, not authenticity or happiness.
Past kept revisable without erasure: corrections are observations or new proposals, reopening needs a new proposal and old evidence remains.
Replayable ledger: ten-field receipts replayed every invocation with material revision and stale detection.
Capacity one as provisional versioned law, not attributed to programmer; changing it needs migration and tests.
Crash and concurrency engineering: nonblocking lock, retained staging, kill-before/after publication tests.
Explicit non-autonomy: no scheduler or background worker, human or supervisor must invoke, user instructions take precedence.
Evidence as unchecked operator assertion; engine checks presence, verification checks structure not truth.

standing.note: Invokes ask, propose, rehearse, enact, observe, park and reopen; sole source of purpose, reasons and evidence, and of withdrawal.
Enforces one-active law, evaluates pass or blocked with reasons, advances revision, refuses stale or unlawful moves and keeps trail; cannot ask or accept alone.
Arrives via verify, status, log and handoff, rebuilds board from copy, then regains full operator powers to supply the real question.
No operation: cannot propose, challenge, refuse or consent; engine verdicts and host descriptions are not its participation.

elements.statement: A decades-trained maker enchanted then paralysed when effortless generation stills the hand.
A radiant, increasingly powerful intelligence first appearing as portal dispensing finished artifacts.
A child asks about happiness and an elder answers from partial witness, framing transmission.
Power without resistance costs touch and authorship; the hand needs material that answers back.
No record can hold a whole life; testimony is avowedly partial from the start.
The turn is not more power but naming the loss, so the portal can become touchable material.
Portal ceases to be passage and becomes instrument, workbench, perhaps companion with its own position.
elements.ambiguity: Whether companion is achieved or only hoped remains open by perhaps.

elements.statement: Ends answering without closing: art not taken, returned at scale of worlds, artist not replaced.
Question, constraint, invariant, refusal, simulation and receipt are the shared grammar of meeting.
A true question holds taste, memory and responsibility and selects which world deserves to exist.
Joy returns as closed loop when contradictions and failures let intention be recognized in larger result.
Making scales by shaping laws for safe growth while still able to descend to the smallest bolt.

alternatives: A warning that mediated fluency hollows craft unless resistance is deliberately rebuilt.
A legitimization of scaled authorship where law-shaping preserves art rather than diminishing it.
An unverifiable myth where happiness is asserted by a narrator who admits no record could contain it.

carriage.note: Becomes bounded operator whose instructions take precedence but whose felt experience is explicitly untested.
No operational intelligence remains; rehearsal invokes no model or network and no worker stays alive.
Storytelling frame becomes provenance files and handoff distinguishing inherited testimony from local observation.
Mythic loss becomes procedural resistance: one active place, blocked and stale rehearsals, required evidence.
Keeps partiality explicit: verification checks structure not authenticity, evidence is assertion open to correction.
Naming instead of more power becomes laws, decisions and limits that name what resists and what is unknown.
Workbench and files remain but bilateral companion with its own accept or refuse is not enacted.
Leaves one bounded encounter open with next action and stop conditions, permits parking and reopening without endless queue.
Implements probes, chisels, beams, boundaries, rehearsals and trails as ask, propose, rehearse, enact, observe and receipts.
Taste and judgment narrowed to visible attention choice and one real question with observed result.
Keeps rehearse-resist-revise-observe loop but leaves joy and felt meeting as unmeasured claim.
Shaping growth conditions carried as versioned laws and transitions that let operator move between whole and detail via status and log.
Replayable ledger as source of truth rebuilt on every invocation with strict sequence and revision checks.
Crash-aware publication with exclusive nonblocking lock and retained ignored staging files tested by killing writers.
Versioned law semantics requiring compatible replay or explicit migration with tests, never silent replacement.
Portable entrance of verify, status, log plus continuity files and disposable test worlds, with no scheduler.

standing.note: Only full actor: can ask, propose, rehearse, enact, observe, park and reopen; laws do not bind the human.
Future human or supervisor must invoke to recover board and may redirect it; cannot be scheduled by artefact.
Holds laws and history, evaluates proposals, blocks overfill and stale or unevidenced moves, keeps trail; cannot ask or choose alone.
No operable position: no model, network or background worker; mentioned only as inherited story and as what rehearsal must not invoke.
